summary: A Yes vote adopts a one percent sales (transactions and use) tax in the City of Mount Shasta, providing approximately $1.5 million annually for general government use until ended by voters.

tax.text: A Yes vote raises the local sales tax to help maintain essential City services.
tax.quote: a one-cent local sales tax increase to help maintain essential City services.

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the proposed local sales tax increase.
